## TRA Timeline

#### Up-C IPO and TRA execution

- 2015-01-09: Form-of TRA filed as Exhibit 10.4 to S-1/A No. 1
- 2015-03-11: IPO closed; executed TRA filed as Exhibit 10.3 to the 8-K dated March 17, 2015

#### Amendment and Blackstone buy-in

- 2023-05-10: Amendment No. 1 (LIBOR-to-SOFR rate replacements; Section 6.3 cooperation language enabling assignment of TRA interests) filed as Exhibit 10.1 to the Q2 2023 10-Q
- 2023-08-18: Summit Materials, LLC purchased Blackstone-affiliated TRA interests for $115.0M (full-year 2023 line "Purchase of tax receivable agreement interests" totaled $132.4M including other smaller holders)
- 2024 (nine months ending Sept 28, 2024): All remaining 763,243 LP Units exchanged for Class A shares, completing the Up-C collapse

#### Quikrete merger and TRA termination

- 2024-11-25: Quikrete Merger Agreement signed; Section 6.07 requires Summit to use reasonable best efforts to terminate the TRA on or before closing
- 2025-02-10: Quikrete merger closed at $52.50/share cash; TRA terminated by extrinsic event pursuant to Section 6.07; Form 25 delisting and Sections 13/15(d) deregistration filed

## Explanation

Summit Materials, Inc. executed this TRA on March 11, 2015 at the closing of its Up-C IPO, agreeing to pay 85% of net cash tax savings from two streams: Section 754 basis step-ups generated by future exchanges of Summit Materials Holdings L.P. units, and the use of pre-IPO NOL carryforwards. The contract was amended once (May 2023) to replace LIBOR-based rate definitions with Term SOFR equivalents and to add a Section 6.3 cooperation provision that enabled Summit LLC's August 2023 cash buy-in of Blackstone-affiliated TRA interests for $115M (with an additional ~$17M paid to other small holders later that year). All remaining LP Units were exchanged for Class A shares during 2024, completing the Up-C collapse and freezing the beneficiary set. The TRA terminated at the February 10, 2025 close of Quikrete Holdings' all-cash acquisition pursuant to Section 6.07 of the Merger Agreement, which contractually obligated Summit to extinguish the TRA on or before closing; no standalone termination instrument was filed and the per-holder termination consideration is not disclosed in any on-EDGAR filing under this CIK (the September 2024 carrying value was $47.7M). See `contract_log.md` for the full filing-by-filing record.
